subject: Customer Rollout Agreement & Owner Timeline (Draft)
messages:
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Samir Kaur <samir@novushealth.com>; Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@novushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft rollout agreement + proposed owners/timeline

Hi Samir / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. I promised to put a compact, owner-focused version of the mutual action plan (MAP) in your hands so we can align on milestones and dates before we circulate the SOW for signatures. Attached is a working spreadsheet (Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a one-page timeline PDF.

High level ask: please confirm the owners on your side and whether the proposed go-live window (week of 2029-08-12) is still realistic. If not, tell us which milestone(s) need to move and why.

Key milestones (summary):
- Integration kickoff (API keys + networking): target 2029-06-10 — Novus owner: IT Lead
- Data mapping & sample data handoff: target 2029-06-21 — Novus owner: Alyssa Turner
- Staging deployment & smoke tests: target 2029-07-12 — Redwood owner: Marissa Cole
- Pilot validation (3 customers): target 2029-07-26 — Redwood owner: Ben Carter / Novus PM
- Go-live (regional roll) target window: 2029-08-12 to 2029-08-16 — joint owners

Can you confirm owners and any constraints by EOD Friday 2029-05-31? After that we'll update the SOW and generate the DocuSign route.

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (attachment), implementation-timeline-compact.pdf (attachment)

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Kaur <samir@novushealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@novushealth.com>; Novus Health IT <it@novushealth.com>
Date: 2029-05-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft rollout agreement + proposed owners/timeline

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick confirmations from our side:
- IT Lead (DevOps) will be Rajesh Menon (cc'd in separate thread to pull him in for the networking window).
- Alyssa will own data mapping and will need two weeks' notice before the data handoff to coordinate with her analytics team.
- The proposed pilot window is workable, but we need to lock the pilot customer list by 2029-06-18 so we can secure consent for the data flows.

One open: the go-live window is fine but Novus legal requested a 14-day review on the SOW once you send the signed draft. We'd like the DocuSign to come after our legal review to avoid rework.

I'll confirm Rajesh and CC him to the integration kickoff thread by tomorrow.

—Samir
VP, Product Operations
Novus Health
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com; Samir Kaur <samir@novushealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2029-05-31T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft rollout agreement + proposed owners/timeline

Adding a condensed owner/responsibility grid below (so we can paste into the SOW and the customer-facing MAP). I kept the same milestone labels Tessa used and added Redwood operational owners.

Owner / Responsibility grid (draft):
- Integration kickoff (networking, firewall rules, API key issuance): Novus: Rajesh Menon (IT) — Redwood: Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng) — Deliverable: network test report by 2029-06-14
- Data mapping & sample handoff: Novus: Alyssa Turner (Data) — Redwood: Monica Patel (Data Integration) — Deliverable: sample dataset + mapping doc by 2029-06-28
- Staging deployment & smoke tests: Redwood: Ben Carter (SRE) — Novus: Rajesh to validate connectivity — Deliverable: pass/fail smoke test report by 2029-07-15
- Pilot validation: Redwood: Ben Carter (Pilot Engineering) & Monica Patel (CS) — Novus: Pilot PM (TBD) — Deliverable: pilot results deck by 2029-07-30
- Go-live readiness review & cutover: Joint — Deliverable: go/no-go sign-off checklist completed by 2029-08-09

Notes / requests:
- We'll add a second column in the spreadsheet for dependencies (legal sign-off, customer opt-ins).
- Monica will own tracking the pilot success metrics and will request the list of pilot customers by 2029-06-18.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Samir Kaur <samir@novushealth.com>; marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2029-06-03T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft rollout agreement + proposed owners/timeline

Samir — appreciate the quick replies and the legal note. Two small follow-ups:
1) Can Novus legal confirm expected review turnaround (you mentioned 14 days) — please mark the calendar so we can adjust the SOW signature milestone.
2) Rajesh: if you or your IT lead can confirm availability for the integration kickoff week (we put 2029-06-10), we can stand up the preflight checklist earlier.

I've also attached a version of the MAP with a short dependency column and a DocuSign placeholder for the SOW route. Once Novus confirms the legal review window, we'll set the DocuSign dates accordingly.

Attachments: SOW_Novus_v1.docx (attachment)

Action items for Novus by 2029-05-31 (pending):
- Confirm Rajesh or IT lead availability for 2029-06-10 integration kickoff (or propose alternate date).
- Confirm pilot customer list by 2029-06-18.
- Confirm legal review window for the SOW.

If we don't hear by EOD 2029-05-31 we'll push the kickoff to the following week.

Thanks —
Tessa
From: Samir Kaur <samir@novushealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@novushealth.com>; Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@novushealth.com>; marissa_cole@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-06-04T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft rollout agreement + proposed owners/timeline

Tessa / team —

Apologies for the delay. Quick updates:
- Rajesh confirmed the 2029-06-10 integration kickoff at 11:00 PT and will join the call.
- Legal confirms a 14-calendar-day review; we'll start review once you send the SOW link (please mark the DocuSign start date no earlier than 2029-06-17).
- Pilot customer list: Alyssa has confirmed two customers and is obtaining consent for a third; final list by 2029-06-18.

Next steps from Redwood: please update the SOW with the legal-review buffer, update the MAP spreadsheet with Rajesh as IT owner, and send the DocuSign route with a start date of 2029-06-17.

Thanks —
Samir
VP, Product Operations
Novus Health
